title: Resolution honoring the history of Seneca Village
summary: This resolution recognizes the historical significance of Seneca Village, a community founded in 1825 by African American landowners that once stood in what is now Central Park. The land was seized through eminent domain in 1856 to build the park, displacing residents and costing many their voting rights tied to property ownership. The resolution calls for further education and programming about the site's history.
